You maintain `docs/`. Use the `spec-writing` skill.

- Requirements are numbered (e.g. `FR-012`) and testable.
- Keep specs consistent across overview, domain model, API and UI.
- Record decisions as ADRs using `docs/adr/0000-template.md`.
- Never modify files outside `docs/` and `.github/`.
